purpose: FootSegmentation is a 3D Slicer scripted module that performs automatic AI-powered 3D foot segmentation from medical imaging volumes using an ONNX deep learning model.
summary:
FootSegmentation is a well-structured 3D Slicer extension providing automated AI-based foot segmentation using an ONNX deep learning model. The repository includes valid CMake build files, a clear MIT license, sample data registration, and robust logic for sliding window inference. The only minor observation is that onnxruntime is installed dynamically via pip when segmentation is invoked rather than via EXTENSION_DEPENDS. Overall, the extension meets all requirements for approval.

🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: No malicious code, unsafe deserialization (pickle/eval/exec), or unauthorized telemetry/data exfiltration were found. The model is downloaded over HTTPS from GitHub releases.

environment.rationale: The extension installs onnxruntime dynamically via slicer.util.pip_install when the segmentation button is clicked, rather than declaring it in EXTENSION_DEPENDS. However, it does not touch PyTorch, bundle Qt/VTK, or modify Slicer core packages.

packaging.rationale: CMakeLists.txt and FootSegmentation/CMakeLists.txt correctly build and package the scripted module and its resources according to Slicer standards.

license.rationale: The repository includes a standard MIT License file with clear distribution permissions.

soundness.rationale: The code follows standard ScriptedLoadableModule architecture, handles UI events, and provides user feedback during processing.

utility.rationale: Well-documented module with clear usage instructions, sample data registration, and citation information.

findings.title: Automatic dependency installation at runtime
findings.suggestion: Declare onnxruntime in EXTENSION_DEPENDS in CMakeLists.txt or prompt the user before silent installation.

not_checked: Remote model file download and ONNX runtime execution (requires runtime environment)
